manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Oblivion Ring until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Oblivion Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Faceless Butcher enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Oblivion Ring enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Faceless Butcher.
Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
